Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE high-quality complete Chinese cultivation game artifact concept illustration, titled only conceptually 'inlaid antique bronze / prohibition engraved into the vessel'. NO visible title or text. A genuinely transparent alpha background surrounds the entire complete artifact. This is a fresh imagined artifact design, not a reproduction of a museum object, previous game asset or previous generated jade/CPU board.

Main artifact: a restrained, substantial OCTAGONAL antique bronze array plate, seen in EXACT ORTHOGRAPHIC 90-DEGREE TOP VIEW. Its planar octagon is regular and fully visible, not a perspective ellipse. Only hairline bevels and low engraved relief indicate depth; no visible tall front face or 3/4 angle. Dark black-brown ancient bronze with localized ink-green verdigris, quiet aged highlights, a few extremely fine restrained inlaid-gold strokes, never a bright gold jewelry frame. The outer rim has a shallow ancient bronze-mirror-like directional ornamental band: abstract non-letter geometric motifs and small incised segment patterns. Separate a small central functional seat, a mostly open working field, and a narrow outer ornamental band through depth and craftsmanship, NOT through boardgame slots or a grid. Keep ample quiet unornamented bronze surface in the main working area. No dragon heads, giant ornaments or large taiji/bagua logo.

Exactly FOUR distinct small installed physical array components on the plate, all individually readable, low-relief finely worked copper/bronze artifacts joined with ancient COPPER WEDGE AND TENON construction, not modern screws, pin headers or industrial machinery:
1) Near the center: one small FLATTENED COPPER SEAL / stabilizing pivot, a compact clipped-corner bronze stamp-like body with an understated dark jade core, NOT a dome gemstone or jewelry medallion.
2) Lower-left: one HORIZONTAL ELONGATED SPIRIT-SAND CASKET, shallow antique bronze with a partly revealed narrow dark mineral core / fine muted spirit sand, a solid little working vessel rather than two gemstones.
3) Upper-left: one SINGLE SHORT COPPER NEEDLE PIVOT held in a tiny dark-jade-and-bronze working base, a concise actual needle component, not a crosshair, compass or pictogram.
4) Right side: one VERTICAL THIN COPPER PAIRED-QUE EXECUTION ASSEMBLY. Two unequal slim blunt-ended bronze rails / low ribs clasp around a narrow dark jade working cavity, fitted together as one distinctive component. NOT a shield shape, shield symbol, standing tower, gold-frame jade pendant or broad gem slab. The whole execution component is vertically elongated and compact.

Two separate functional routes are CUT INTO THE BRONZE SURFACE, not overlaid UI: a narrow hairline inlaid-gold COMMAND ROUTE links the upper-left needle to the central pivot and then to the upper part of the right execution assembly. A slightly wider cool desaturated cyan-green ETCHED POWER GROOVE leads from the lower-left casket along the lower working field, bends upward and reaches the lower part of the right execution assembly. These two routes must be visibly continuous and bent, have tiny dark cut edges and shallow recessed depth, remain separate without crossings, and terminate at the actual components. The gold route is thin; the cyan route is a modestly wider fine carved channel, never a pipe, hose, fat flat colored ribbon, neon light or printed modern PCB trace. Quiet, intricate restraint; the magical prohibition feels engraved INTO an ancient vessel.

Art direction: refined gongbi ink contours with high-quality restrained watercolor/mineral tint, low-saturation ancient copperware, tangible subtle patina and precise low-relief edges. Calm aged artifact, complete and serviceable rather than shattered ruin. Readable overall silhouette and four differentiated component silhouettes at game-prop scale. Fill about 90% of a square canvas with the octagonal complete artifact, leave a small clean transparent margin. NO paper/card backdrop or floor shadow. NO visible grid, cells, boardgame/chess slots, text, numerals, Chinese characters, labels, arrows, UI, flags, enormous taiji icon, jade-jewelry set, modern chips, microprocessor packages, plastic, pin rows, steam gears, tube pipes or oversized glowing effects.
